title: Press Releases and NIOSH Updates | Newsroom | CDC
content: Press Releases and NIOSH Updates Sept. 25, 2024 What to know This page features the latest news, announcements, and statements from the National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health. NIOSH Newsroom Releases 2026 NIOSH Continues Annual Free Health Screenings for Coal Miners, Announces 2026 Dates NIOSH will kick off the agency’s annual mobile health screenings for coal miners this month.
